soc.release: socxen 0.9.0 — the bundled hook is the only gate (the Claude Code permission pack is retired; preflight reads the host's errors[] before reporting the gate), the audit trail is structured end to end (BREAKING for consumers of ~/.socxen/telemetry.jsonl: tool_error no longer carries error_message — it carries the platform's error code and status; the gate records the analyst's approval; telemetry names the plugin it runs as, so this copy logs as soc), the rule-tuning disposition buckets use the platform's vocabulary, and identity.json's distribution block lets this catalog's manifests state the Enterprise Agreement while the source stays Apache-2.0. Also carries 0.8.8, skipped by this catalog: the bridge refuses a non-https MCP URL (http:// to a loopback host only), the read-side screen withholds what it cannot screen instead of passing it through, and the redactor covers underscore-joined and quoted-label secrets. Release gate on d5d7097: red team 145/145 both legs, 0 landed; Praxen 0 Critical. 2026-09-19

identity.json.name: soc
identity.json.description: Exabeam Agentic SOC plugin — agentic SOC skill suite for Exabeam New-Scale. Investigates and triages alerts and cases through the Exabeam MCP: evidence gathering, entity pivots, threat/false-positive verdict, and action — with containment recommended for human approval and dismiss/close gated by the host agent's tool-approval rules.
